solutions.latex:
Pythagoras: $x^2 + 24^2 = 30^2$, so $x^2 = 324$ and $x = 18$ m.

Area of triangle $= \dfrac{1}{2} \times 18 \times 24 = 216\text{ m}^2$.

Area of semicircle $= \dfrac{\pi \times 15^2}{2} = 353.4291735\text{ m}^2$.

Total area $= 353.4291735 + 216 = 569.4291735 \approx 569\text{ m}^2$.

solutions.latex:
Substitute $(4, 5)$, i.e. $x = 4$, $y = 5$.

$y = 3x - 7$: $5 = 3(4) - 7 = 12 - 7 = 5$, LHS = RHS.

$x - 2y + 6 = 0$: $4 - 2(5) + 6 = 4 - 10 + 6 = 0$, LHS = RHS.

Therefore yes, the student is correct.
